claims.subject: Randomized Monte Carlo Algorithm
claims.evidence_quote: We present randomized (Monte Carlo) algorithms that achieve sublinear and subquadratic message complexity in the socalled implicit version and explicit version, respectively, when tolerating more than a constant fraction of the faulty nodes.
